fixes.explanation: Yes, friend. “Even if He causes grief, He will show compassion according to His abundant loving devotion.” Grief is real in this poem, and the writer says so out loud. But compassion follows right in the same verse, tied to His abundant loving devotion. Hold onto that pairing, because the verse puts the two side by side.
